meta.name: azure-pricing
meta.description: Fetches real-time Azure retail pricing using the Azure Retail Prices API (prices.azure.com) and estimates Copilot Studio agent credit consumption. Use when the user asks about the cost of any Azure service, wants to compare SKU prices, needs pricing data for a cost estimate, mentions Azure pricing, Azure costs, Azure billing, or asks about Copilot Studio pricing, Copilot Credits, or agent usage estimation. Covers compute, storage, networking, databases, AI, Copilot Studio, and all other Azure service families.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询任意Azure服务实时价格并估算Copilot Studio用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要查询Azure服务价格或做成本估算。
copy.tagline_en: Query real-time Azure pricing and estimate Copilot Studio usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need Azure service pricing or cost estimates.

howto.what: 装上后，当用户询问Azure服务成本时，Claude会调用Azure零售价格API获取实时价格，并可估算Copilot Studio的月度费用。他能展示价格对比表，包括按需、预留实例、节省计划等选项。
howto.when: 用户询问任何Azure服务的成本、比较SKU价格、需要成本估算数据，或询问Copilot Studio定价、信用或代理使用估算时触发。

say.text: 查一下D4s v5虚拟机在美东的价格。
say.note: Claude会调用API查询并展示价格。

say.text: 比较一下标准存储账户在西部欧洲和东南亚的定价。
say.note: Claude会获取并对比两地价格。

say.text: 估算1000个用户使用Copilot Studio agent的月度费用。
say.note: Claude会计算信用消耗和美元金额。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will fetch real-time Azure retail pricing via the Azure Retail Prices API and estimate monthly Copilot Studio agent credit consumption. It can present comparison tables for pay-as-you-go, reserved instances, savings plans, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about the cost of any Azure service, compares SKU prices, needs a cost estimate, or inquires about Copilot Studio pricing, Copilot Credits, or agent usage estimation.

say_en.text: Check the price of a D4s v5 VM in East US.
say_en.note: Claude will query the API and show the price.

say_en.text: Compare storage pricing between West Europe and Southeast Asia.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch and compare prices.

say_en.text: Estimate monthly cost for a Copilot Studio agent with 1000 users.
say_en.note: Claude will calculate credits and estimated USD cost.
